notes: Measured on fpE in the registered global frame (reg.json tilt 0). The drawing has a residual rotation on this sheet: vertical wall lines drift +0.005 m per m of z (+0.29 deg) and horizontal lines -0.009 m per m of x (-0.52 deg), i.e. ~0.4 deg plus slight shear. Walls are kept axis-aligned at their locally measured centres (each segment within ~2-3 cm of the drawing); as a result the same physical line can sit at slightly different z/x on the two halves (e.g. north face -2.665 at x~4.5 vs -2.75 at x~13.5; living south walls 5.25 vs 5.175; bedroom south walls 11.73 vs 11.62).

Envelope on this sheet: west wall faces 0.02..0.24, east wall faces 17.70..17.90 (17.9 m vs the 18.00 chain); mamad south outer face 11.77 (frame reference 11.75). Upper floors (fpD/fpC) put E's west/east walls at ~0.17-0.21 / 17.96 - a 5-15 cm registration difference between sheets, not corrected here.
Building M2 abuts E's west wall from z ~0.6 to 7.6 (its own blue wall x -0.17..-0.03); not modelled. North of it the yard fence continues the line (x -0.18).

Thicknesses: exterior block walls 0.20-0.22, concrete core/L-wall 0.21, mamad 0.20 (south 0.30), partitions 0.10 (labels '10'), storeroom/stair partition 0.12. The shelter south wall and the bedroom south walls are not collinear (bedroom outer face 5 cm further south in apt 1).

Window labels on the north side are written rotated and read '230/270', '70/120', '105/120' (height first) while the drawn gaps (2.65-2.75, 1.21-1.25, 1.22) show widths 270 / 120 / 120: openings use w x h = 270x230, 120x70, 120x105. South labels read normally (120/105, 100/100, 80/210). Sills: 2.15-h (README) except the mamad windows (1.00, as read on the south elevation for the upper floors).

Wet rooms are not named on fpE: bath (bathtub 240), laundry 160x160 (washing machine, door from the bath), WC (150) named from fixtures as on fpD. Apt 2 en-suite: only 'ונטה' (exhaust fan) is written - named 'מקלחת' from the shower tray. Apt 1 hall has no name (dims 135/270/235); apt 2 hall is written 'פ. עבודה' (kind laundry per the task mapping).

Open-plan splits (no walls drawn): apt 1 dining/living at z 2.80 ('פ. אוכל' written at z~2.35, 'ח. מגורים' at z~3.3); kitchen 1 ends at z 1.78; apt 2 dining/living at x 13.65, kitchen 2 ends at z 1.135.

Storeroom 106 / 'לובי': both names are written inside one enclosure (L-shaped concrete wall, mamad wall, 12 cm stair partition, storeroom north wall with a 70 door). The line at z 5.97 between the names is the 205/295 dimension line and lines at z 7.12 / x 7.78 are dimension lines (410, 280), so no wall separates them; the 'לובי' has no other access. Kept as two polygons with a virtual boundary at z 5.97 - merge if wanted. Area table lobbies 30.04 = 11.88 (entrance) + 9.54 (stair) + 4.73 + 3.89 (lobby in front of apt-2 door ~ x 8.97..11.11, z 3.23..5.04).

Building entrance: the lobby's north side is a thin double line (mailbox + intercom unit 'מיקום תיבות דאר + אינטרקום') with a door unit labelled 230/130 (= 130 wide x 230 high) whose 1.1 leaf is hinged at x 6.05 and opens outwards into the pilotis; modelled as a 0.20 wall at z 1.78 with an 'entry' opening 1.30 wide.

Entrance steps in the pilotis (x 5.92..7.57, z -2.78..-0.70, '8X17/30') connect the north forecourt (245.25, ~1.1 m below the pilotis 246.33 and ~1 m below the yards) with the pilotis; up = south. East of them an L-shaped low wall (0.17) encloses x 7.75..8.86, z -2.69..-0.65 (planter or light well - not specified). No stair to the basement is drawn on fpE; the -2.60 storerooms 101-105 and their stair are drawn only on the development plan (p0_site, under the north part of the building), so E0.json was NOT produced from this sheet.
Main stair: same U-stair as upper floors; on ±0.00 it starts with the east flight going south. No lift in E.

Gardens: only the two north yards carry 'חצר פרטית' labels (apt 1: 21 m2, apt 2: 92 m2). Their polygons go to fence centres/plot line: yard 1 ~24.6 m2; yard 2 north part ~59 m2 + the strip east of the building and the south-east garden (~53 m2). The south garden (to the 'גבול מגרש' double line at z ~15.05) is split by a fence with x marks at x 9.0; its halves are assigned to apt 1 / apt 2 by position (not written). Garden levels -0.10 (246.30) with marks 246.15-246.40.
